attempts.fix: Require an entitlement productIds array containing the selected product before finishing or returning fulfilled.
SQLite inspect returns willRenew as 0; assert that storage value and separately assert the API boolean false. Runtime cancellation behavior was unchanged.
Show a short event-delivery outcome; keep the actual response in an expandable preformatted block.

comparison.finding: IAPKit replacement checks already assert the selected product is in the app backend productIds response. The host adapter now enforces that same condition before finish. This run did not start IAPKit or claim a new interop result.

limits: Store purchase callback, evidence, user session, and clock are fixtures.
The denial endpoint is a demo control; it is not a Commerce Protocol operation.
SQLite reopening is in-process; it is not OS crash recovery.
No real store, mobile SDK checkout, external product integration, revenue calculation, production deployment, or full profile conformance was tested.
Passing these example checks does not verify a different project. Run equivalent checks against that implementation.
